    "infoenergo-ui/src/composables/AiTabs/useTabsBaseOperations.ts": {
      "functions": [
        {
          "name": "useTabsBaseOperations",
          "line": 98,
          "isAsync": false,
          "isExported": true,
          "params": [],
          "returnType": "import(\"/home/sergei/Desktop/system/packages/ast-analyzer/infoenergo-ui/src/composables/AiTabs/useTabsBaseOperations\").UseTabsBaseOperationsReturn",
          "calls": [
            "isInTabBarFunc",
            "setTabs",
            "setActiveTab"
          ],
          "calledBy": [],
          "body": "{\n    const { homeView, activeTab, tabs, setActiveTab, setTabs, resetTabState } = useTabsState();\n\n    const getTabInstanceByTitle = (title: string) => {\n        return tabs.value.find((x: Tab) => x.title === title);\n    };\n\n    const isInTabBarFunc = (tab: Tab) => {\n        const tabsList = tabs.value;\n        const isInTabBar = !!tabsList.find((x: Tab) => {\n            if (x.extensionName && tab.extensionName) {\n                return x.extensionName === tab.extensionName;\n            }\n            return x.title === tab.title;\n        });\n        const tabInstance: Tab | undefined = tabsList.find((x: Tab) => {\n            if (tab.extensionName) {\n                return x.extensionName === tab.extensionName;\n            }\n            return x.title === tab.title;\n        });\n        return { isInTabBar, tabInstance };\n    };\n\n    const addTabToTabBar = (tab: Tab) => {\n        const { isInTabBar, tabInstance } = isInTabBarFunc(tab);\n        if (!isInTabBar) {\n            setTabs({ tabs: [...tabs.value, tab], activeTab: tab });\n        } else {\n            setActiveTab(tabInstance as Tab);\n        }\n    };\n\n    const removeTabFromTabBar = (tabName: string) => {\n        const currentTabs = tabs.value;\n\n        if (currentTabs.length === 1) {\n            return;\n        } else if (tabName === homeView.title) {\n            return;\n        }\n\n        const index: number = currentTabs.findIndex((x: Tab) => tabName === x.title || tabName === x.viewId);\n        if (index === -1) return;\n\n        const nextTabs = [...currentTabs];\n        nextTabs.splice(index, 1);\n\n        const isRemovingActive = activeTab.value.title === tabName;\n        const nextActiveTab = isRemovingActive\n            ? (nextTabs[Math.min(index, nextTabs.length - 1)] ?? nextTabs[0] ?? homeView)\n            : activeTab.value;\n\n        setTabs({ tabs: nextTabs, activeTab: nextActiveTab as Tab });\n\n        if (!isRemovingActive) {\n            const stillExists = nextTabs.some(x => x.viewId === (nextActiveTab as Tab).viewId);\n            if (!stillExists) {\n                setTabs({ tabs: nextTabs, activeTab: homeView });\n            }\n        }\n    };\n\n    const tabClick = (tabName: string) => {\n        const foundTab: Tab | undefined = tabs.value.find((x: Tab) => tabName === x.title);\n        if (foundTab) {\n            setActiveTab(foundTab);\n        } else {\n            setActiveTab(homeView);\n        }\n    };\n\n    const modifyTab = (tabName: string) => {\n        const currentTabs = tabs.value;\n\n        const updatedTabs = currentTabs.map((tab: Tab) =>\n            tab.title === tabName ? { ...tab, isModified: !tab.isModified } : tab\n        );\n\n        const updatedActive = updatedTabs.find((tab: Tab) => tab.title === tabName) ?? (activeTab.value as Tab);\n\n        setTabs({ tabs: updatedTabs, activeTab: updatedActive });\n    };\n\n    /**\n     * Обновляет userData у вкладки по title или viewId.\n     *\n     * @function\n     * @param {string} tabKey - Название вкладки (title) или её viewId\n     * @param {any} payload - Данные для записи в userData\n     */\n    const setTabUserData = (tabKey: string, payload: any) => {\n        const currentTabs = tabs.value;\n        const targetTab = currentTabs.find((tab: Tab) => tab.title === tabKey || tab.viewId === tabKey);\n        if (!targetTab) return;\n\n        const updatedTabs = currentTabs.map((tab: Tab) =>\n            tab.title === tabKey || tab.viewId === tabKey ? { ...tab, userData: payload } : tab\n        );\n\n        const updatedActive =\n            activeTab.value.title === tabKey || activeTab.value.viewId === tabKey\n                ? ({ ...activeTab.value, userData: payload } as Tab)\n                : (activeTab.value as Tab);\n\n        setTabs({ tabs: updatedTabs, activeTab: updatedActive });\n    };\n\n    /**\n     * Изменение статуса поля isModified у вкладки по полю title\n     * @param tabName Название вкладки\n     * @param value(default: false) Новое значение поля isModified\n     * @returns void\n     */\n    const modifyTabByTabName = (tabName: string, value: boolean = false) => {\n        const currentTabs = tabs.value;\n        const updateTabs = currentTabs.map((tab: Tab) => (tab.title === tabName ? { ...tab, isModified: value } : tab));\n        setTabs({ tabs: updateTabs, activeTab: activeTab.value });\n    };\n\n    return {\n        homeView,\n        tabs,\n        activeTab,\n        setActiveTab,\n        modifyTab,\n        modifyTabByTabName,\n        setTabUserData,\n        setTabs,\n        resetTabState,\n        isInTabBarFunc,\n        addTabToTabBar,\n        removeTabFromTabBar,\n        tabClick,\n        getTabInstanceByTitle,\n    };\n}",

          "calls": [],
          "calledBy": [],
          "body": "{\n    const homeView: Tab = {\n        title: '',\n        viewId: 'home-view',\n        routeName: 'home-view',\n        isModified: false,\n        userData: {},\n        isClosable: false,\n    };\n\n    const state: TabState = reactive<TabState>({\n        activeTab: homeView,\n        tabs: [homeView],\n    });\n\n    const activeTab = computed(() => readonly(state.activeTab));\n\n    const setActiveTab = (tab: Tab): void => {\n        state.activeTab = tab;\n    };\n\n    const tabs = computed(() => readonly(state.tabs));\n\n    const setTabs = (newTabs: TabState) => {\n        state.tabs = newTabs.tabs;\n        state.activeTab = newTabs.activeTab;\n    };\n\n    const resetTabState = () => {\n        state.tabs = [homeView];\n        state.activeTab = homeView;\n    };\n\n    return {\n        homeView,\n        activeTab,\n        tabs,\n        setActiveTab,\n        setTabs,\n        resetTabState,\n    };\n}",

    "infoenergo-ui/src/composables/AiTabs/useTabsScroll.ts": {
      "functions": [
        {
          "name": "useTabsScroll",
          "line": 17,
          "isAsync": false,
          "isExported": true,
          "params": [
            "tabsRootRef"
          ],
          "returnType": "{ scrollLeft: () => void; scrollRight: () => void; }",
          "calls": [
            "getTabsScrollContainer"
          ],
          "calledBy": [],
          "body": "{\n    /**\n     * Возвращает DOM-контейнер горизонтального скролла табов.\n     *\n     * @returns {HTMLElement | null} Контейнер скролла или null.\n     */\n    const getTabsScrollContainer = () => {\n        return tabsRootRef.value?.querySelector('.v-x-scroll') as HTMLElement | null;\n    };\n\n    /**\n     * Прокручивает панель вкладок влево на фиксированный шаг.\n     */\n    const scrollLeft = () => {\n        const container = getTabsScrollContainer();\n        if (container) {\n            container.scrollBy({ left: -TABS_SCROLL_STEP, behavior: 'smooth' });\n        }\n    };\n\n    /**\n     * Прокручивает панель вкладок вправо на фиксированный шаг.\n     */\n    const scrollRight = () => {\n        const container = getTabsScrollContainer();\n        if (container) {\n            container.scrollBy({ left: TABS_SCROLL_STEP, behavior: 'smooth' });\n        }\n    };\n\n    return {\n        scrollLeft,\n        scrollRight,\n    };\n}",

DEFAULT_KEY_EXPR;\n    /** Ключ строки, на которой фокусируется таблица */\n    const focusedRowKey = ref<RowKey | null>(null);\n    /** Ключи строк, выделенных в таблице */\n    const checkedRowKeys = ref<RowKey[]>([]);\n    /** Ссылка на данные таблицы */\n    const data = ref<DataTableRowData[]>([]);\n\n    /** Функция для получения ключа строки */\n    const getRowKey = (row: DataTableRowData) => row[keyExpr];\n    /** Проверяет, является ли строка фокусированной */\n    const isFocusedRow = (row: DataTableRowData) => row[keyExpr] === focusedRowKey.value;\n    /** Проверяет, является ли строка выделенной */\n    const isCheckedRow = (row: DataTableRowData) => checkedRowKeys.value.includes(row[keyExpr]);\n    /** Сбрасывает выделенные строки */\n    const resetState = (incomingData: DataTableRowData[]) => {\n        data.value = incomingData;\n        focusedRowKey.value = incomingData.at(0)?.[keyExpr] ?? null;\n        checkedRowKeys.value.length = 0;\n    };\n\n    /** Синхронизирует выделенные строки */\n    const syncState = () => {\n        focusedRowKey.value = data.value.find(row => row[keyExpr] === focusedRowKey.value)?.[keyExpr] ?? null;\n        checkedRowKeys.value = data.value\n            .filter(row => checkedRowKeys.value.includes(row[keyExpr]))\n            .map(row => row[keyExpr]);\n    };\n\n    /** Устанавливает фокус на строку */\n    const setFocusedRow = (row: DataTableRowData) => {\n        focusedRowKey.value = row[keyExpr];\n    };\n\n    return {\n        keyExpr,\n        focusedRowKey,\n        checkedRowKeys,\n        getRowKey,\n        resetState,\n        syncState,\n        isFocusedRow,\n        isCheckedRow,\n        setFocusedRow,\n    };\n}",

Сохранить изменения?',\n                positiveText: 'Да',\n                negativeText: 'Нет',\n                neutralText: 'Отмена',\n            });\n            if (choice === 'positive') {\n                const success = await saveData();\n                return success;\n            }\n            if (choice === 'negative') {\n                const success = await getData();\n                if (success) resetChanges();\n                return success;\n            }\n            if (choice === 'neutral') return false;\n        }\n        const success = await getData();\n        return success;\n    };\n\n    /**\n     * Сохраняет данные на сервер и сбрасывает состояние изменений\n     */\n    const saveData = async () => {\n        const updatedRowKeys = getUpdatedRowKeys();\n        const insertedRowKeys = getInsertedRowKeys();\n        const success = await setData(updatedRowKeys, insertedRowKeys);\n        if (success) {\n            resetChanges();\n            await loadData();\n        }\n        return success;\n    };\n\n    /**\n     * Создает новую строку и отслеживает ее\n     */\n    const createRow = (focusedRowKey: RowKey | null) => {\n        const newRowKey = insertNewRow(focusedRowKey);\n        trackInsert(newRowKey);\n    };\n\n    /**\n     * Удаляет строки из данных и отслеживает удаленные строки\n     *\n     * @param keys - Массив ключей строк\n     */\n    const removeRows = async (keys: RowKey[]) => {\n        const choice = await dialog.show({\n            content: 'Строки будут безвозвратно удалены.           "calledBy": [],
          "body": "{\n    const message = useMessage();\n\n    const fieldKeys = meta.value.columns.flatMap(column =>\n        column.displayField ? [column.dataField, column.displayField] : column.dataField\n    );\n\n    /** Массив с модифицируемыми данными */\n    const data = reactive<DataTableRowData[]>([]);\n    const loading = ref<boolean>(false);\n\n    const getDataRowByKey = (key: RowKey) => data.find(row => row[keyExpr] === key);\n    const getDataRowIndexByKey = (key: RowKey) => data.findIndex(row => row[keyExpr] === key);\n\n    const get = meta.value.api.get;\n    const set = meta.value.api.set;\n    const getNewRowData = () => ({\n        ...Object.fromEntries(fieldKeys.map(field => [field, null])),\n        [keyExpr]: Math.random(),\n        isNewRow: true,\n    });\n    const getNewCopiedRowData = (key: RowKey) => {\n        const row = getDataRowByKey(key);\n        return {\n            ...row,\n            [keyExpr]: Math.random(),\n            isNewRow: true,\n        };\n    };\n\n    /**\n     * Получает данные с сервера и обновляет локальное состояние\n     */\n    const getData = async () => {\n        try {\n            loading.value = true;\n            const response = await get();\n            if (response.success) {\n                message.success('Данные успешно загружены');\n                const newData = response?.data ?? [];\n                data.length = 0;\n                data.push(...newData);\n                return true;\n            } else {\n                message.error(`Ошибка при загрузке данных: ${response.error}`);\n                return false;\n            }\n        } catch (error) {\n            console.error('Failed to fetch table data:', error);\n            const errorMessage = error instanceof Error ? error.message : String(error);\n            message.error(`Ошибка при загрузке данных: ${errorMessage}`);\n            return false;\n        } finally {\n            loading.value = false;\n        }\n    };\n\n    /**\n     * Отправляет данные на сервер (в разработке)\n     *\n     * @todo Добавить body\n     * @todo Реализовать обновление локальных данных после успешной отправки\n     */\n    const setData = async (updatedDataKeys: RowKey[], insertedDataKeys: RowKey[]) => {\n        if (!set) {\n            console.error('apiSet is not defined');\n            return;\n        }\n\n        const modifiedData = {\n            insertDataArgs: insertedDataKeys.map(getDataRowByKey).filter(row => row !== undefined),\n            updateDataArgs: updatedDataKeys.map(getDataRowByKey).filter(row => row !== undefined),\n            deleteDataArgs: [],\n        };\n\n        try {\n            loading.value = true;\n            const response = await set(modifiedData);\n            if (response.success) {\n                message.success('Данные успешно сохранены');\n                return true;\n            } else {\n                message.error(`Ошибка при сохранении данных: ${response.error}`);\n                return false;\n            }\n        } catch (error) {\n            console.error('Failed to send data:', error);\n            const errorMessage = error instanceof Error ? error.message : String(error);\n            message.error(`Ошибка при сохранении данных: ${errorMessage}`);\n            return false;\n        } finally {\n            loading.value = false;\n        }\n    };\n\n    /**\n     * Изменяет значение поля в строке по ключу строки\n     *\n     * @param key - Значение ключа строки (`row[keyExpr]`)\n     * @param dataField - Название поля для изменения\n     * @param value - Новое значение\n     */\n    const updateRowField = (key: RowKey, dataField: string, newValue: DataFieldValue) => {\n        const rowData = getDataRowByKey(key);\n\n        if (!rowData || !(dataField in rowData)) return;\n        const oldValue = rowData[dataField];\n        rowData[dataField] = newValue;\n\n        return oldValue;\n    };\n\n    /**\n     * Добавляет новую строку в начало массива\n     */\n    const insertNewRow = (focusedRowKey: RowKey | null) => {\n        const newRow: DataTableRowData = getNewRowData();\n        const focusedRowIndex = focusedRowKey !== null ? getDataRowIndexByKey(focusedRowKey) : -1;\n        const newRowIndex = focusedRowIndex + 1;\n        data.splice(newRowIndex, 0, newRow);\n        return newRow[keyExpr];\n    };\n\n    /**\n     * Удаляет строки из массива по ключам\n     *\n     * @param keys - Массив ключей строк\n     *\n     * @returns true, если строки были удалены, false в противном случае\n     */\n    const deleteRows = async (keys: RowKey[]) => {\n        if (!set) {\n            console.error('apiSet is not defined');\n            return;\n        }\n\n        const onlyExistedRows = keys.filter(key => getDataRowByKey(key)?.isNewRow === undefined);\n        const onlyNewRows = keys.filter(key => getDataRowByKey(key)?.isNewRow === true);\n\n        const deleteNewRows = () => {\n            onlyNewRows.forEach(key => delete data[getDataRowIndexByKey(key)]);\n        };\n\n        if(onlyExistedRows.length === 0) {\n            deleteNewRows();\n            message.success('Данные успешно удалены');\n            return true;\n        }\n\n        const modifiedData = {\n            insertDataArgs: [],\n            updateDataArgs: [],\n            deleteDataArgs: onlyExistedRows.map(getDataRowByKey).filter(row => row !== undefined),\n        };\n\n        try {\n            loading.value = true;\n            const response = await set(modifiedData);\n            if (response.success) {\n                message.success('Данные успешно удалены');\n                deleteNewRows();\n                return true;\n            } else {\n                message.error(`Ошибка при удалении данных: ${response.error}`);\n                return false;\n            }\n        } catch (error) {\n            console.error('Failed to send data:', error);\n            const errorMessage = error instanceof Error ? error.message : String(error);\n            message.error(`Ошибка при удалении данных: ${errorMessage}`);\n            return false;\n        } finally {\n            loading.value = false;\n        }\n    };\n\n    const createCopiedRow = (focusedRowKey: RowKey) => {\n        const copiedRow = getNewCopiedRowData(focusedRowKey);\n        const focusedRowIndex = focusedRowKey !== null ? getDataRowIndexByKey(focusedRowKey) : -1;\n        const newRowIndex = focusedRowIndex + 1;\n        data.splice(newRowIndex, 0, copiedRow);\n        return copiedRow[keyExpr];\n    };\n\n    return {\n        data,\n        loading,\n        getData,\n        getDataRowIndexByKey,\n        setData,\n        updateRowField,\n        insertNewRow,\n        createCopiedRow,\n        deleteRows,\n    };\n}",

          "returnType": "{ isDirty: import(\"/home/sergei/Desktop/system/packages/ast-analyzer/infoenergo-ui/node_modules/@vue/reactivity/dist/reactivity\").ComputedRef<boolean>; resetChanges: () => void; getUpdatedRowKeys: () => RowKey[]; getInsertedRowKeys: () => any[]; isNewRow: (key: RowKey) => boolean; isModified: (key: RowKey, dataField: string) => boolean; trackInsert: (key: RowKey) => void; trackUpdate: (key: RowKey, dataField: string, oldValue: DataFieldValue, newValue: DataFieldValue) => void; trackDelete: (keys: RowKey[]) => void; }",
          "calls": [

          ],
          "calledBy": [],
          "body": "{\n    /** Мапа: ключ записи -> { измененное поле: оригинальное значение } */\n    const rowChangesByRowKey = reactive(new Map<RowKey, RowChanges>());\n\n    /** Сет: ключи новых записей */\n    const newRowKeys = reactive(new Set<RowKey>());\n\n    /** Флаг, показывающий, есть ли изменения/новые записи */\n    const isDirty = computed(() => rowChangesByRowKey.size > 0 || newRowKeys.size > 0);\n\n    /** Проверяет, является ли запись новой */\n    const isNewRow = (key: RowKey) => newRowKeys.has(key);\n\n    /** Ключи записей с изменениями */\n    const getUpdatedRowKeys = () => Array.from(rowChangesByRowKey.keys());\n\n    /** Ключи новых записей */\n    const getInsertedRowKeys = () => Array.from(newRowKeys);\n\n    /** Сбрасывает состояние изменений */\n    const resetChanges = () => {\n        rowChangesByRowKey.clear();\n        newRowKeys.clear();\n    };\n\n    /**\n     * Проверяет, модифицировано ли поле в записи\n     *\n     * @param key - Значение ключа строки (`row[keyExpr]`)\n     * @param dataField - Название поля для проверки\n     *\n     * @returns true, если значение было изменено, false в противном случае\n     */\n    const isModified = (key: RowKey, dataField: string): boolean => {\n        if (isNewRow(key)) return true;\n        return !!rowChangesByRowKey.get(key)?.[dataField];\n    };\n\n    /**\n     * Отслеживает добавление новой строки\n     *\n     * @param row - Новая строка\n     */\n    const trackInsert = (key: RowKey) => {\n        newRowKeys.add(key);\n    };\n\n    /**\n     * Отслеживает изменение существующей записи\n     *\n     * @param key - Значение ключа записи\n     * @param dataField - Название изменяемого поля\n     * @param oldValue - Предыдущее значение поля\n     * @param newValue - Новое значение поля\n     */\n    const trackUpdate = (key: RowKey, dataField: string, oldValue: DataFieldValue, newValue: DataFieldValue) => {\n        if (isNewRow(key)) return;\n\n        const rowChanges = rowChangesByRowKey.get(key);\n\n        // Первая правка записи\n        if (rowChanges === undefined) {\n            // Создаем объект с изменениями\n            const newField: RowChanges = {\n                [dataField]: {\n                    originalValue: oldValue,\n                    currentValue: newValue,\n                },\n            };\n            // Записываем объект с изменениями в updatedRows\n            rowChangesByRowKey.set(key, newField);\n            return;\n        }\n\n        const hasField = dataField in rowChanges;\n\n        // Первое изменение этого поля в записи\n        if (!hasField) {\n            // Сохраняем оригинальное значение для поля\n            const newFieldChange: FieldChange = { originalValue: oldValue, currentValue: newValue };\n            rowChanges[dataField] = newFieldChange;\n            return;\n        }\n\n        const fieldChange = rowChanges[dataField];\n        if (!fieldChange) return;\n\n        const originalValue = fieldChange?.originalValue;\n\n        // Новое значение не равно оригинальному значению\n        if (!Object.is(newValue, originalValue)) {\n            fieldChange.currentValue = newValue;\n            return;\n        }\n\n        delete rowChanges[dataField];\n\n        // Удаляем запись из updatedRows, если больше нет изменений\n        if (Object.keys(rowChanges).length === 0) rowChangesByRowKey.delete(key);\n    };\n\n    const trackDelete = (keys: RowKey[]) => {\n        keys.forEach(key => newRowKeys.delete(key));\n        keys.forEach(key => rowChangesByRowKey.delete(key));\n    };\n\n    return {\n        isDirty,\n        resetChanges,\n        getUpdatedRowKeys,\n        getInsertedRowKeys,\n        isNewRow,\n        isModified,\n        trackInsert,\n        trackUpdate,\n        trackDelete,\n    };\n}",

          "params": [],
          "returnType": "{ filterState: any; setFilterInput: (dataField: string, filterInput: string | [string, string] | null, dataType?: DataType) => void; buildNaiveFilterValues: (state: FilterStateByColumn) => Record<string, string | [string, string]>; updateFilterState: (dataField: string, dataType: DataType) => void; getNaiveFilterConfigFunction: (userColumnConfig: UserOnlyColumn, value: import(\"/home/sergei/Desktop/system/packages/ast-analyzer/infoenergo-ui/node_modules/naive-ui/es/data-table/src/interface\").FilterOptionValue, row: import(\"/home/sergei/Desktop/system/packages/ast-analyzer/infoenergo-ui/node_modules/naive-ui/es/data-table/src/interface\").InternalRowData) => boolean; applyFilterSelection: (dataField: string, dataType: DataType, selection: string) => void; }",

          "calledBy": [],
          "body": "{\n    const filterState = reactive<FilterStateByColumn>({});\n\n    const ensureColumnFilter = (dataField: string, dataType: DataType = 'string'): ColumnFilterState => {\n        if (!filterState[dataField]) {\n            filterState[dataField] = createDefaultColumnFilterState(dataType);\n        }\n\n        return filterState[dataField]!;\n    };\n\n    const updateFilterState = (dataField: string, dataType: DataType) => {\n        filterState[dataField] = createDefaultColumnFilterState(dataType);\n    };\n\n    const setFilterInput = (\n        dataField: string,\n        filterInput: string | [string, string] | null,\n        dataType: DataType = 'string'\n    ) => {\n        const column = ensureColumnFilter(dataField, dataType);\n\n        column.filterInput = filterInput ?? '';\n    };\n\n    const buildNaiveFilterValues = (state: FilterStateByColumn): Record<string, string | [string, string]> => {\n        return Object.fromEntries(Object.entries(state).map(([dataField, column]) => [dataField, column.filterInput]));\n    };\n\n    const getNaiveFilterConfigFunction = (\n        userColumnConfig: UserOnlyColumn,\n        value: FilterOptionValue,\n        row: InternalRowData\n    ) => {\n        if (userColumnConfig.dataType === 'boolean') {\n            const columnState = filterState[userColumnConfig.dataField];\n            if (!columnState || columnState.filterOperation === 'reset' || !columnState.filterInput) {\n                return true;\n            }\n            return Boolean(row[userColumnConfig.dataField]) === (columnState.filterInput === 'true');\n        }\n\n        const unifiedRowValue = String(row[userColumnConfig?.displayField ?? userColumnConfig.dataField]).toLowerCase();\n        const unifiedFilterValue = String(value as string).toLowerCase();\n        return Boolean(~unifiedRowValue.indexOf(unifiedFilterValue));\n    };\n\n    const applyFilterSelection = (dataField: string, dataType: DataType, selection: string) => {\n        const column = ensureColumnFilter(dataField, dataType);\n\n        if (dataType === 'boolean') {\n            Object.assign(column, toBooleanFilterState(selection));\n            return;\n        }\n\n        column.filterOperation = selection;\n    };\n\n    return {\n        filterState,\n        setFilterInput,\n        buildNaiveFilterValues,\n        updateFilterState,\n        getNaiveFilterConfigFunction,\n        applyFilterSelection,\n    };\n}",

          "returnType": "number",
          "calls": [
            "String",

          ],
          "calledBy": [],
          "body": "{\n    const normalizedValue = String(value).trim();\n    const dateTimeMatch = normalizedValue.match(/^(\\d{2})\\.(\\d{2})\\.(\\d{4})(?:,\\s*(\\d{2}):(\\d{2}):(\\d{2}))?$/);\n    if (!dateTimeMatch) {\n        return NaN;\n    }\n    const [, day, month, year, hours = '0', minutes = '0', seconds = '0'] = dateTimeMatch;\n    return new Date(\n        Number(year),\n        Number(month) - 1,\n        Number(day),\n        Number(hours),\n        Number(minutes),\n        Number(seconds)\n    ).getTime();\n}",

        {
          "name": "makeSorter",
          "line": 20,
          "isAsync": false,
          "isExported": true,
          "params": [
            "dataField",
            "dataType"
          ],
          "returnType": "(leftRow: Record<string, unknown>, rightRow: Record<string, unknown>) => number",
          "calls": [
            "Number",
            "parseRussianDateTimeToTimestamp",
            "Boolean",
            "String"
          ],
          "calledBy": [],
          "body": "(leftRow: Record<string, unknown>, rightRow: Record<string, unknown>) => {\n        const leftValue = leftRow[dataField];\n        const rightValue = rightRow[dataField];\n\n        if (leftValue === null && rightValue === null) return 0;\n        if (leftValue === null) return 1;\n        if (rightValue === null) return -1;\n\n        if (dataType === 'number') {\n            return Number(leftValue) - Number(rightValue);\n        }\n\n        if (dataType === 'date' || dataType === 'datetime') {\n            return parseRussianDateTimeToTimestamp(leftValue) - parseRussianDateTimeToTimestamp(rightValue);\n        }\n\n        if (dataType === 'boolean') {\n            return Number(Boolean(leftValue)) - Number(Boolean(rightValue));\n        }\n\n        return String(leftValue).localeCompare(String(rightValue), 'ru');\n    }",
          "startLine": 20,
          "endLine": 43,
          "isMethod": false,

          ],
          "returnType": "{ fieldComponent: import(\"/home/sergei/Desktop/system/packages/ast-analyzer/infoenergo-ui/node_modules/@vue/reactivity/dist/reactivity\").ShallowRef<import(\"/home/sergei/Desktop/system/packages/ast-analyzer/infoenergo-ui/node_modules/@vue/runtime-core/dist/runtime-core\").Component | null>; propAliases: import(\"/home/sergei/Desktop/system/packages/ast-analyzer/infoenergo-ui/node_modules/@vue/reactivity/dist/reactivity\").ShallowRef<Record<string, string>>; mergedComponentProps: import(\"/home/sergei/Desktop/system/packages/ast-analyzer/infoenergo-ui/node_modules/@vue/reactivity/dist/reactivity\").Ref<Record<string, any>, Record<string, any>>; }",
          "calls": [
            "defaultProps",
            "setComponent",
            "setPropAliases",
            "setMergedComponentProps",
            "initComponent"
          ],
          "calledBy": [],
          "body": "{\n    const fieldType: FieldType = editor ? editor.type : dataType;\n\n    /** Динамический компонент */\n    const fieldComponent: ShallowRef<Component | null> = shallowRef(null);\n\n    /** Псевдонимы пропсов */\n    const propAliases: ShallowRef<Record<string, string>> = shallowRef({});\n\n    /** Объединенные пропсы (дефолтные и пользовательские) */\n    const mergedComponentProps: Ref<Record<string, any>> = ref({});\n\n    const setComponent = () => {\n        const { component } = DEFAULT_COMPONENTS[fieldType];\n        fieldComponent.value = component;\n    };\n\n    const setPropAliases = () => {\n        const { propAliases: incomingPropAliases } = DEFAULT_COMPONENTS[fieldType];\n        propAliases.value = incomingPropAliases;\n    };\n\n    const setMergedComponentProps = () => {\n        const { defaultProps } = DEFAULT_COMPONENTS[fieldType];\n\n        const props = editor ? defaultProps(editor) : defaultProps();\n\n        // что-то глобально зарегистрированное, поэтому используем компонент\n        if (editor && component) {\n            mergedComponentProps.value = {\n                ...props,\n                idKey: component.id,\n                textKey: component.text,\n                componentName: component.name,\n                editorConfig: editor.config,\n            };\n        }\n        // только если существует редактор без компонента, следовательно это selector\n        else if (editor) {\n            mergedComponentProps.value = {\n                ...props,\n                idKey: editor.id,\n                textKey: editor.text,\n                editorConfig: editor.config,\n            };\n        }\n        // ничего не существует, следовательно это обычное поле\n        else {\n            mergedComponentProps.value = props;\n        }\n    };\n\n    const initComponent = () => {\n        setComponent();\n        setPropAliases();\n        setMergedComponentProps();\n    };\n\n    initComponent();\n\n    return {\n        fieldComponent,\n        propAliases,\n        mergedComponentProps,\n    };\n}",
          "startLine": 15,

    "infoenergo-ui/src/composables/common/useFetch.ts": {
      "functions": [
        {
          "name": "useFetch",
          "line": 10,
          "isAsync": false,
          "isExported": true,
          "params": [
            "baseUrl"
          ],
          "returnType": "{ loading: import(\"/home/sergei/Desktop/system/packages/ast-analyzer/infoenergo-ui/node_modules/@vue/reactivity/dist/reactivity\").Ref<boolean, boolean>; error: import(\"/home/sergei/Desktop/system/packages/ast-analyzer/infoenergo-ui/node_modules/@vue/reactivity/dist/reactivity\").Ref<string | null, string | null>; send: (endpoint: string, body?: object, customHeaders?: object) => Promise<any>; }",
          "calls": [
            "fetch",
            "String"
          ],
          "calledBy": [],
          "body": "{\n    /** Флаг загрузки  */\n    const loading = ref<boolean>(false);\n\n    /** Сообщение об ошибке */\n    const error = ref<string | null>(null);\n\n    /**\n     * Отправляет POST-запрос на указанный эндпоинт\n     *\n     * @param endpoint - Относительный путь API (добавляется к baseUrl)\n     * @param [body] - Тело запроса в формате объекта (сериализуется в JSON)\n     * @param [customHeaders] - Дополнительные HTTP-заголовки\n     *\n     * @returns Результат запроса в виде объекта или null при ошибке\n     */\n    const send = async (endpoint: string, body: object = {}, customHeaders: object = {}) => {\n        loading.value = true;\n        error.value = null;\n\n        try {\n            const url = `${baseUrl}/${endpoint}`;\n\n            const response = await fetch(url, {\n                method: 'POST',\n                headers: {\n                    'Content-Type': 'application/json',\n                    Accept: 'application/json',\n                    ...customHeaders,\n                },\n                body: JSON.stringify(body),\n            });\n\n            if (response.status === 204) {\n                return { success: true };\n            }\n\n            if (!response.ok) {\n                throw new Error(`HTTP ${response.status}`);\n            }\n\n            const result = await response.json();\n            return result;\n        } catch (err) {\n            console.error('POST error:', err);\n\n            if (err instanceof Error) {\n                error.value = err.message;\n            } else {\n                error.value = String(err);\n            }\n\n            throw err;\n        } finally {\n            loading.value = false;\n        }\n    };\n\n    return {\n        loading,\n        error,\n        send,\n    };\n}",
          "startLine": 10,
          "endLine": 73,
